videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of the provided YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences, and absolutely no English.
Key points from the transcript:
1. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang held an impromptu press conference in Taiwan after GTC Taipei
2. He mentioned visiting Korea to celebrate achievements of Korean companies, especially SK Hynix's HBM (High Bandwidth Memory), emphasizing close relationship with NVIDIA
3. He praised Korean companies' intelligence and technology, specifically mentioning robotics as next-gen technology where NVIDIA wants to contribute
4. He said he would hold GTC in Seoul if Korea wants it, expressing special affection for Korea since GeForce early days, praising imagination, creativity, and ambition
5. He distributed chicken to reporters and citizens, saying Korean chicken is the best
6. Attendees at the dinner included executives from SK Hynix, Naver Cloud, Samsung Electronics, LG Science Park
7. He will meet with Korean conglomerate heads from May 5th: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won, LG Group Chairman Koo Kwang-mo, Naver Chairman Lee Hae-jin. Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Chung Euisun is coordinating schedule, Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong will be absent due to overseas schedule.
8. Likely dinner location is a pork belly restaurant in Seongsu-dong, Seoul.
